tasks.subject: Task 0: Theme type
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Device-neutral palette of semantic roles with grayscale default + Paper Pro color palette.

**Files:** create crates/inkapp-core/src/theme.rs; modify crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs (pub mod theme; pub use theme::Theme;)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core theme::

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/theme.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core theme::", "acceptanceCriteria": ["grayscale paper None and Default==grayscale", "indigo_tomato Paper Pro colors + paper Some", "Theme is Debug+Clone+PartialEq"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Thread theme through render driver
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Carry a Theme from App into RenderCx via RenderEnv, zero change to existing renders under default grayscale.

**Files:** modify crates/inkapp-core/src/component.rs (RenderCx.theme + with_theme); modify crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs (RenderEnv + From<PageGeom>; geom params -> impl Into<RenderEnv>; page fill; App.theme + .theme() builder); modify crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs (re-export RenderEnv); create crates/inkapp-core/tests/theme_threading.rs

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/component.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/theme_threading.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RenderCx theme default grayscale + with_theme", "page fill only when paper Some", "PageGeom sites still compile via From", "App .theme() builder + threads to render", "workspace green no golden drift"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Harness rasteriser + golden pagination test

**Files:** modify crates/inkapp-harness/src/inspector.rs (rasterize/encode_png/render_page; inspect reuses); create crates/inkapp-harness/tests/index_render.rs; create (bootstrap then commit) crates/inkapp-harness/tests/golden/index_page0.png + index_page1.png

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness --test index_render

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-harness/src/inspector.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/index_render.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/golden/index_page0.png", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/golden/index_page1.png"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness --test index_render", "acceptanceCriteria": ["render_page clean no overlays", "inspect unchanged behavior", "pages==2 + idx regions both pages + two goldens"]}
```
